name: 天龙八部
english_description: An incomplete 2000-01 TLBB mudlib shipped as a ZIP misnamed .tgz: daemons/feature/obj plus area trees (Kaifeng, Luoyang, Juxianzhuang, …) but no master/simul_efun source (only MudOS MASTER.B / simul_efun.b binaries), no cmds/, no std/, no /t/tutor start room. Ported onto this collection's es2 work/ skeleton, with the DOS-uppercase trees lowercased onto /adm/daemons, /feature, /obj, and /t/<area>. Port 40269.
